criterion_fired: CRITERION 4 (Actionable Next Steps) and CRITERION 5 (No Unsupported Claims)
suggested_change: Criterion 4 should explicitly require format: '[Contact Name]: [Specific action verb: Ask/Confirm/Request] on [timeframe]: "[Exact question without hedging]"' and list forbidden vague verbs (Map, Walk through, Test, Understand, Propose). Criterion 5 should clarify that evidence statements must be extractable from call transcript, not inferred from deal context or previous stages.
